## Description

## Type of change

- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] Refactoring (`refactor`)
- [ ] Tests (`test`)
- [ ] CI/CD or configuration (`chore`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)

## Checklist

- [ ] The code compiles without errors
- [ ] The tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] The lint is clean (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] The formatting is correct (`npm run format`)
- [ ] Migrations are verified (if applicable)
- [ ] No forgotten `console.log` statements
- [ ] No dead code or commented-out blocks
